full_judgment: 4. The petitioner has no property within the Chittagong City Town or elsewhere and he never purchased any property jointly with his brother. His elder brother namely Mr. Gias Uddin has purchased two gonda land at 'Niribili Housing Society' of the Chittagong City town and the said property is his personal property. The petitioner and his other brothers have no right, title and interest in the purchased 1150 satangsha and 100 satangsha land from B.S. plot No.233/234 under B.S. Khatian No.1058 vide kabala No.8794 dated 14-12-2002 for fishing project. From B. S. Khatian it would be clear that the purchased land is almost a pond. There is no vacant residential plot in that purchased property. The petitioner has no residential plot for residing in Chittagong City Town. The petitioner resides as a tenant in a rented house. The allegation against the petitioner is totally false, collusive and has got no basis. The petitioner requested the respondent No.2 to issue allotment letter in favour of him and thereafter repeatedly requested the respondents in writing but no reply was given by the respondent.
